title: Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter: Tax Years Covered and Issue
content:
**Rule.** Each tax year of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** receives one annual letter, issued with a January letter run: the letter for the year just ended is issued in the January that follows it, and a letter the January run missed is issued with the next January run, never twice for the same tax year.

**Year covered.** The annual letter covers a tax year other than the one in which the agreement ended; the tax year it covers is the year after the latest tax letter on the agreement's ledger, or the year of the first entrance fee payment when there is none.

## Reading the ledger for the year covered (hypothetical ledgers)

| Tax letters on the agreement's ledger | First entrance fee payment | Year the agreement ended | Tax year of the next annual letter |
|---|---|---|---|
| Latest letter for 2022 | 2019 | Still in force | 2023 |
| None | 2021 | Still in force | 2021 |
| Latest letter for 2022 | 2019 | 2024 | 2023; the year 2024 is not covered by an annual letter |

Each tax year receives its annual letter once; a year that already carries a tax letter on the ledger does not receive another.

## Issuing the letter

The letter is issued with the tool `issue_annual_tax_letter_ce10c97a`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. It enters one tax letter entry stating the medical expense amount given on the agreement's ledger, dated today and marked with the tax year; the refundable balance is not changed. The letter is sent to the mailing address on file. The tool computes nothing and checks nothing of its own.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `entrance_agreement_id` | Reference number of the Entrance Fee Agreement the letter is issued for, read from the entrance fee agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `tax_year` | The tax year the letter covers | Four digits, YYYY |
| `medical_expense_amount` | The medical expense amount the letter states | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, entered rounded half up to the cent |

**Receipt.** On success: `status` ("letter_issued"); `entrance_agreement_id`; `entrance_entry_id` (reference number of the tax letter entry); `tax_year` (YYYY); `medical_expense_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `issue_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
